name: branch-management
description: Branch lifecycle skills backed by subagents: new-branch cuts a fresh branch; new-pr runs iterative parallel review rounds (claude/codex/copilot/coderabbit reviewers), applies verified fixes between rounds, opens a PR/MR via gh or glab, and watches CI until green. Optionally refreshes a graphify output folder on new-branch and before the PR push (separate commit). Script execution and heavy output processing run through the context-mode plugin (declared cross-marketplace dependency).

review_claude.title: Claude reviewer
review_claude.description: Run the claude-reviewer subagent during new-pr review rounds

review_codex.title: Codex reviewer
review_codex.description: Run the codex-reviewer subagent (requires codex CLI login)

review_copilot.title: Copilot reviewer
review_copilot.description: Run the copilot-reviewer subagent (requires copilot CLI login)

review_coderabbit.title: CodeRabbit reviewer
review_coderabbit.description: Run the coderabbit-reviewer subagent (requires coderabbit CLI login)

ci_monitor.title: CI monitoring
ci_monitor.description: Watch CI results after the PR/MR is opened (new-pr final phase)

context_index.title: context-mode indexing
context_index.description: Refresh the context-mode index after creating a new branch

coderabbit_ci_comments.title: CodeRabbit CI comments
coderabbit_ci_comments.description: Collect and address open CodeRabbit bot comments while watching CI

graphify_branch_update.title: graphify update on new branch
graphify_branch_update.description: Refresh the graphify output (graphify update -o graphify-out) after creating a new branch

graphify_force_create.title: graphify force create
graphify_force_create.description: new-branch only: run the graphify update even when graphify-out/ is missing and create the folder first (fail-closed: only an explicit true enables this)

graphify_pr_update.title: graphify update before PR
graphify_pr_update.description: Refresh the graphify output after the review rounds and before pushing in new-pr (requires an existing graphify-out/ folder)

graphify_pr_commit.title: graphify separate commit
graphify_pr_commit.description: Commit refreshed graphify-out files as a separate commit during new-pr (when disabled, graphify changes stay uncommitted)
